name: cache-watch
description: Shows a card above the prompt when the prompt cache is expired or the context is large, and offers a handover to a new session.

cacheTtlMinutes.title: Prompt cache lifetime (minutes)
cacheTtlMinutes.description: How long Anthropic keeps the prompt cache after the last request: 60 on a subscription, 5 in usage overage.

contextLimits.title: Context limits (handover hint / new-session warning)
contextLimits.description: The context sizes, in tokens, for the amber card and the red card. Use the first value on a model with a 200k context window.
